method: The decisions rest on mission-coverage-v1328j on candidate 1214cp in Edge of the World under the product controller, both source roles: the mission's native quick slots (D-pad Left pistol, Right crossbow, Up sleep darts, Down Blink; chapter 85) drive the switches, the partner is checked from its own presentation state on the observer (ranged kind and variants, presentation weight at every sample) and the source's native player states are polled. Lifecycle: the mission take re-arms the product controller after its map load, resets the source between cases and ends with the lab checkpoint restore and protected-file check.

items.scope: With the crossbow drawn, selecting sleep darts (the native ammo switch, equip change 64) and switching back to bolts in both roles: the partner presents the crossbow through both switches (59 samples, variants 0 and 7-10), fires one dart, and never drops the presentation.

visual.verdict: Corvo holds the crossbow aimed through the dart selection, raises it to fire a dart, re-aims after switching back and finally lowers his arm to holster.

items.scope: Aiming the pistol and switching to the crossbow mid-aim, selecting Blink, holstering and redrawing in both roles: the partner presents the pistol (20-21 samples), then the crossbow (24-26), lowers it for Blink and presents the redrawn crossbow (27-28), with no presentation drop.

visual.verdict: Emily raises the pistol, swaps to the wrist crossbow without lowering her arm fully, drops the arm when Blink is selected, then raises the crossbow again and puts it away.
